transcript:
Speaker A: Have you lost your mind?
Speaker B: Isa, I feel like you're upset. And know what cures being upset? A warm embrace.
Speaker A: Get out. Everything was perfect. Abuela was happy. The family was happy. You want to be a better sister? Apologize for ruining my life. Go on. Apologize.
Speaker B: I am sorry...
Speaker C: Best language learning app. Download now.

summary: The ad showcases a shadow reading exercise using a popular scene from the movie Encanto to help users practice English. The spoken dialogue is highlighted on-screen to guide pronunciation and rhythm. It concludes with a call to action to download the Lingo AI app.
